values.note: $8/night for a single site, $16 for a double site.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bishop-knob-campground ('Single Site: $8 per night, Double Site: $16 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351905/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026: WalkInSingleCampsite $8, WalkInDoubleCampsite $16), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First come, first served: recreation.gov lists only a 'First-come, First-served Season' rate and shows every site 'Not Reservable'. One wheeled camping unit, up to 8 people and 2 vehicles per single site. Check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/10351905/month (June 2027: all 54 sites 'Not Reservable') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bishop-knob-campground ('Maximum length of stay is 14 days.', 'Check-out time is 2:00 p.m.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two loops with 48 single and 6 double sites, each with a gravel parking spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bishop-knob-campground ('Sites will accommodate up to 40 ft. RV. There are two loops with 48 single campsites and 6 double sites. Each site features a picnic table, fire ring, lantern pole, gravel parking spur'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bishop-knob-campground ('There is no electric available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351905 (notice 'No RV hookups are available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Four accessible vault toilets. No dump station: two private dump stations and water fill in Richwood; Cranberry Campground has a donation dump station.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bishop-knob-campground ('Four accessible vault toilets', 'No dump station available at Campground. There are two privately owned dump stations in Richwood, WV.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page and recreation.gov: $8 single / $16 double (high raised from $8), first-come only (all sites 'Not Reservable' on rec.gov; overrides the inherited reservable row), 14-day max, 54 sites to 40 ft, no hookups, four vault toilets, no dump. Not stated: drinking water, season (rec.gov's FCFS season May 18 - Sep 8, 2026 is a rate season). Gauley Ranger District; no concessioner named. Note unchanged.
flags: Missing agency website: the Forest Service page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bishop-knob-campground (the entry has only the recreation.gov page, which takes no reservations here).
Missing phone: Gauley Ranger District (304) 846-2695 (FS page and recreation.gov).
Inherited federal booking row (reservable via recreation.gov, 180-day window) is wrong here; this result overrides it with first-come only.
Inclusion evidence cites only Campendium; the FS page now confirms it: 'Sites will accommodate up to 40 ft. RV.'

Road caveat (not a closure of the campground): the FS's Richwood approach uses FR 76 to FR 81, and Forest Order 09-21-02-26-05 closes FR 76 section 1 (38.2622,-80.5191 to 38.2862,-80.5323) from Sept 8 to Nov 20, 2026. The Dyer approach (WV 46 to FR 101, 3 miles) is unaffected.
